IntroducedBillHeader.Sponsors: House Public Safety (originally sponsored by Representatives Moscoso, Takko, Ryu, and Hope; by request of Liquor Control Board)

Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning state liquor control board enforcement officers.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to state liquor control board enforcement officers;amending RCW 43.101.020; and adding a new section to chapter 43.101RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 43.101.020 and 1974 ex.s. c 94 s 2 are each amended toread as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: There is hereby created and established a state commission to beknown and designated as the Washington state criminal justice trainingcommission. The purpose of such commission shall be to provide programs andstandards for the training of criminal justice personnel including, butnot limited to, peace officers and enforcement officers of the stateliquor control board.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 43.101 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Admittance to the commission's basic law enforcement academy is p. 1 SHB 2394open to all law enforcement personnel including an employee who is apeace officer or enforcement officer of the state liquor control board.
